data.title: 优香 · 周末书店的小票
data.description: 周末的街角书店门外，优香穿着米色风衣、奶油色高领毛衣和藏青格裙，肩上挎着小黑包。她一手抱住刚买的两本书，另一手看着收据核对金额，确认无误后露出轻松的笑容——「书买到了，预算也正好。接下来可以慢慢逛回去。」
data.action: 站在书店门外，一手抱住两本书，另一手查看收据
data.promptProse: Standing just outside a corner neighborhood bookstore on a weekend afternoon in her cropped camel jacket, ivory blouse, and navy A-line skirt, Yuuka tucks two newly purchased books securely against one arm with a small black bag slung at her shoulder. With her free hand, she holds up the printed paper receipt to verify the total, relaxing into a satisfied, pleased smile once every yen balances with her budget. Gentle afternoon daylight reflects off the bookstore display window and warms the quiet streetfront.
data.lighting: 书店橱窗前温和的午后日光
data.animaCaption: Outside the corner bookstore in her camel jacket and navy A-line skirt, Yuuka hugs two new books against one arm while checking the paper receipt in her other hand with a satisfied smile. Soft afternoon daylight glows across the bookshop display window.
